transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I’m here because everybody keeps acting like I’m just imagining it. But I know my wife’s relative came into this house to get at me. I mean... my tools don’t move themselves. And my fishing plans don’t get spoiled by accident every single weekend. After all these months, I can see plain as day he’s been trying to take over my place and push me out. They wanted me to come talk to somebody about it, so here I am, but that's what's going on.
Do you think your wife's relative is the only person involved in trying to get at you?

Well... no, I haven't noticed anybody else. Far as I can tell, it's just him. I mean, I don't know why anyone else would be involved or have a reason to bother me. He's the one I always catch hanging around right before my gear gets messed with. So, yeah, I'm pretty sure it's just him doing it.
Do you think this relative's actions against you are part of a larger plan or organization?

No, I don't think it's anything like that. I mean... I haven't seen any signs of a big group or some organization, if that's what you're asking. Like I said, it just seems to be him. I don't know why anyone else would care about my house or my tools anyway. It's just him trying to push me out, plain and simple. I haven't noticed anyone else or any kind of larger plan involved.
Would you say that the idea of your wife's relative trying to take over your place and push you out is something that most people would find hard to believe or unusual?

Well... yeah, I suppose they do. Like I said when I first sat down, everybody keeps acting like I’m just imagining the whole thing. My wife, the rest of the family... they just shake their heads or tell me I'm getting worked up over nothing. 

So I guess to them, it is hard to believe. But I'm the one dealing with it. I'm the one who goes out to the garage and finds my stuff messed with. To me, it's just what's happening, plain and simple. But to answer your question... yeah, other people seem to think it's unusual.
Do you think there's any chance you could be mistaken about your wife's relative trying to get at you?

No, I'm not mistaken. I know what I see. I'm only here talking to you because everybody keeps acting like I'm imagining the whole thing. But I know he's coming into this house to get at me. 

My tools don't just move themselves around the garage. My fishing plans don't just happen to get spoiled by accident every single weekend. It's been going on for months now, and it's plain as day to me. He's trying to take over my place and push me out. I'm not mistaken about that at all.
Would you describe the idea of your wife's relative trying to take over your place as something that could happen in real life?

Well, yeah, of course it could happen in real life. It *is* happening in real life. I mean... people get greedy, right? People try to take advantage of family all the time. 

It's not like I'm saying aliens are coming down to steal my garage. It's just a guy... a guy who wants what I have and is trying to drive me crazy so I'll leave. That happens every day. So yeah, it's definitely something that happens in the real world.
Do you think about your wife's relative trying to get at you all the time, or are there times when you don't think about it at all?

I don't really know. I haven't kept track of it like that. I mean... I'm not thinking about it every single second. When I'm at work, I'm just focused on my job. But it's hard not to think about it when I get home and see my things have been messed with again. So I guess there are times I don't think about it, sure. I just couldn't tell you exactly how often that is.
How long have you believed your wife's relative is trying to take over your place and push you out?

It's been about nine months now. It started right around the time he moved into our house. Before that, everything was fine, but ever since he got settled in, that's when all this started happening. So yeah, I'd say right at nine months.
Would you describe the ways your wife's relative is trying to get at you as unusual or strange to most people?

I don't think it's strange. I mean, it's just... it's just sneaky, you know? Like I said, it's moving my tools around in the garage, or changing the settings on my chair in the living room, or leaving a light on that I know I turned off. 

If you told most people about it, they might just think I'm being forgetful or something. It's not like he's doing anything crazy or out of a movie. It's just small, annoying things to try and make me feel like I'm losing my mind in my own house. So no, I wouldn't say it's unusual... it's just a really underhanded way to get rid of someone.
How much of your daily thoughts are occupied with the idea that your wife's relative is trying to get at you?

I don't really have a set amount or, you know, a percentage for you. Like I mentioned a minute ago, when I'm at the shop working, my mind is on my job. I have to pay attention to what I'm doing. 

But... once I pull into the driveway and walk through the front door, it's pretty much on my mind the rest of the night. I'm always looking around to see what he moved or messed with this time. So I couldn't tell you exactly how much of the whole day it takes up. I just know it's a big chunk of my evening when I'm supposed to be relaxing.
Have you developed a detailed theory or explanation for why your wife's relative is trying to take over your place and push you out?

No, I don't have some big detailed theory. I mean... I don't know exactly what goes on in his head. 

I just know he wants my spot. He moved in, he got comfortable, and now I'm in his way. I haven't sat around trying to figure out some grand explanation for it or anything like that. I just see what he's doing every day. He wants me gone so he can have the run of the place, and that's pretty much all there is to it. I don't really need a big theory to see what's right in front of me.
Have your thoughts about your wife's relative trying to get at you changed at all over the past nine months?

No, they haven't changed. If anything, I'm just more sure of it now. I'm here talking to you because everybody else keeps acting like I'm imagining things. But I know he came into this house to get at me. 

My tools in the garage don't just move themselves. My fishing plans don't get spoiled by accident every single weekend. It's been going on for months, and I can see it plain as day. He's trying to take over my place and push me out. It's just obvious.
Would you say the things your wife's relative is doing to try and get at you are things that could be done by a normal person?

Well, yeah, of course. I mean... moving a wrench or messing with my fishing gear, anybody can do that. It doesn't take any special skills or, you know, superpowers or anything. He's just a regular guy who's being sneaky when I'm not looking. So, sure, a normal person could definitely do all of it. He just happens to be the one doing it to me.
Have you ever had a period of time where you didn't believe your wife's relative was trying to get at you?

No, not really. I mean... ever since this whole thing started, it's been pretty constant. I haven't had any reason to think otherwise, because he just keeps doing it. So, no, there hasn't been a time where I didn't believe it. It's just been going on the whole time he's been here.
Do you think there's anything that could happen that would make you change your mind about your wife's relative trying to get at you?

Change my mind? No, I don't see how. Like I was saying before... everybody just keeps acting like I'm imagining it. But I'm not. I know my wife's relative came into this house to get at me. 

Unless someone can prove to me that my tools are somehow moving themselves, or that my fishing plans are just getting spoiled by accident every single weekend... no. I'm not going to just change my mind. After all these months, it's plain as day to me. He's been trying to take over my place and push me out. I can't just pretend it isn't happening when the proof is right there in my own house.
Do you think your wife's relative is using any unusual or supernatural methods to try and get at you?

No, no... nothing like that. Like I said a minute ago, it's just normal stuff. He's not using magic or... or anything supernatural. 

He just waits until I'm out of the house or busy in another room. It's just plain old sneaking around behind my back. You don't need superpowers to move a man's tools or mess up his fishing line. You just need to be sneaky. So, no, there's nothing unusual about how he's doing it. He's just doing it.
Do you think your wife's relative is trying to harm you in a way that's unusual or doesn't make sense to other people?

No, not at all. It makes perfect sense. I mean... he wants me out of the picture so he can have the place to himself. What's unusual about that? It's just greed. 

Other people might say it doesn't make sense to them, but that's just because they don't see what goes on when they aren't looking. To me, there's nothing weird or complicated about it. He's just trying to make me miserable enough to pack up and leave. It's pretty straightforward sabotage, really. Nothing unusual about it.
Do you think there's any possibility that your beliefs about your wife's relative could change if you found out more information about what's actually going on?

Look, like I keep saying... I don't know what kind of new information you think is out there. I'm really only here right now because everybody keeps acting like I'm imagining it. 

But I know what I see. I know my wife's relative came into this house to get at me. What kind of information is going to change the fact that my tools don't move themselves? Or that my fishing plans don't just get spoiled by accident every single weekend? 

There isn't anything else to find out. After all these months, I can see it plain as day. He's been trying to take over my place and push me out. So no, I don't see my mind changing, because I already have the information. I know what's actually going on.
Do you think there's any possibility that you might be wrong about your wife's relative trying to get at you, even if it seems real to you?

No, I'm not wrong. Like I just said, I'm only sitting here talking to you because my family acts like I'm making this all up. But I'm not. 

I know what's real. My tools do not just pick themselves up and walk away. My fishing trips don't just happen to get ruined every single time I try to go. It's been going on for months now, and I can see exactly what he's doing. He came into my house to mess with me, to make me so miserable I'll just leave, so he can take over my place. I'm not wrong about this. I know what I'm seeing.
